title.en: Introduction to Philosophy: Knowledge and Reality

examFormat.zh: 两次测验各 50 分钟、各占 20%：测验 1（10 月 14 日，第 2–5 周）已经考完；测验 2 在 11 月 23 日周一，考测验 1 之后到考试前的全部内容（第 7–10 周）。大纲只说题型会包括选择题、简答题、小论文中的部分或全部，没有写各有几道。每周辅导课练习占 20%（共 11 次，取最好的 9 次）。期末考试 3 小时、占 40%，考全学期内容。
examFormat.en: Two 50-minute tests worth 20% each: Test 1 (Oct 14, Weeks 2-5) has been written; Test 2 is on Monday Nov 23 and covers all course content after Test 1 up to the test (Weeks 7-10). The syllabus says the question types will include some or all of multiple-choice, short-answer and short-essay questions, without saying how many of each. Weekly tutorial exercises are worth 20% (11 in total, best 9 count). The 3-hour final exam is cumulative and worth 40%.

note.zh: 按大纲组卷：50 分钟，选择题、简答题、小论文都有可能。大纲没有写各有几道，这里先按 15 道选择或判断 + 3 道简答或小论文来练；真实题量以老师在 Quercus 公布为准。
note.en: Built from the syllabus: 50 minutes, with multiple-choice, short-answer and short-essay questions all possible. The syllabus does not say how many of each; this paper uses 15 objective questions and 3 written ones. Check Quercus for the real numbers.

detail.zh: 已经考完。50 分钟，考到测验前的全部内容：哈特、罗素《哲学的价值》、柏拉图《申辩篇》《游叙弗伦篇》《美诺篇》、笛卡尔第一和第二沉思。这几周的内容期末还会考。
detail.en: Already written. 50 minutes on all course content up to the test: Hart, Russell's 'The Value of Philosophy', Plato's Apology, Euthyphro and Meno, and Descartes' First and Second Meditations. These weeks come back on the final.

detail.zh: 11 月 23 日周一上课时间考（这门课周一下午 1–2 点在 IB 120 上课），50 分钟。考测验 1 之后到考试前的全部内容：罗素《哲学问题》第 1–2 章、范·因瓦根《客观性》、休谟《人类理解研究》第 4–5 节、古德曼《归纳的新之谜》、内格尔《成为一只蝙蝠是什么样的》、查默斯谈上传与意识、辛顿的视频讲座、查默斯谈语言模型，再加上课堂讲的内容。辛顿的视频本站没有资料。
detail.en: Monday Nov 23 in class (the course meets Mondays 1:00-2:00 PM in IB 120), 50 minutes. Covers all course content after Test 1 up to the test: Russell, The Problems of Philosophy, Chs. 1-2; van Inwagen, 'Objectivity'; Hume, Enquiry, Sections 4-5; Goodman, 'The New Riddle of Induction'; Nagel, 'What Is It Like to Be a Bat?'; Chalmers on uploading and consciousness; Hinton's video lecture; Chalmers on language models; and the lectures. The station has no material on Hinton's video.

detail.zh: 从第 2 周开始，每周在辅导课上写一次书面练习，满分 5 分，共 11 次，取最好的 9 次。不能补交。
detail.en: Weekly written exercises in tutorials from Week 2, marked out of 5; 11 in total and the best 9 count. They cannot be made up.

detail.zh: 3 小时，考全学期内容，题型包括选择题、简答题、小论文中的部分或全部。日期由教务处在考试周安排。
detail.en: 3 hours, cumulative across the course, with some or all of multiple-choice, short-answer and short-essay questions. The date is set by the Registrar in the final exam period.

title.zh: 哲学是什么：惊奇与追问
title.en: What philosophy is: wonder and questioning

oneLiner.zh: 哈特说：哲学开始于对“竟然有东西存在”的惊奇，这个谜不是物理原因能解开的；罗素说：哲学的价值不在确定的答案，而在它的问题能让心灵摆脱偏见、变得自由而广大。
oneLiner.en: Hart says philosophy begins in wonder that anything exists at all, a mystery no physical cause can explain; Russell says philosophy's value lies not in definite answers but in questions that free the mind from prejudice and make it great.

oneLiner.zh: 《申辩篇》：七十岁的苏格拉底在法庭上为自己的一生辩护——他唯一的智慧是不以为自己知道不知道的事，他宁可服从神、继续审视别人，也不怕死。《游叙弗伦篇》：他请自称精通神事的游叙弗伦说清“虔敬是什么”，五个定义一个个被驳倒，最后没有答案。
oneLiner.en: In the Apology, Socrates defends his life of questioning: his only wisdom is that he does not think he knows what he does not know, and he will obey the god rather than stop, even when facing death. In the Euthyphro, every definition of piety that Euthyphro offers fails under his questioning.

oneLiner.zh: 美诺问“美德能教吗”，苏格拉底说要先知道“美德是什么”；三次定义都失败后，他用“学习就是回忆”回答“探究不可能”的悖论，并让奴隶男孩做几何题来演示；后半篇他改用假设法，最后区分知识和真意见，暂时得出：美德像是神赐的正确意见。
oneLiner.en: Meno asks whether virtue can be taught; Socrates insists on first asking what virtue is, answers Meno's paradox with the theory of recollection and the slave-boy demonstration, and ends, provisionally, with virtue as god-given right opinion, which differs from knowledge by not being tied down by an account of the reason why.

title.zh: 笛卡尔论怀疑与确定性

oneLiner.zh: 笛卡尔先用一层比一层强的怀疑（感官、做梦、骗人的上帝）把旧信念全部先放一边，再有意假设一个恶魔来抵抗习惯，然后找到连最强的骗子也动摇不了的一点：只要我在思考，我就存在；我是一个思维之物；而且（蜡块告诉我们）心灵比物体更清楚地被认识。
oneLiner.en: Descartes sets aside all his old beliefs with stronger and stronger reasons for doubt (the senses, dreaming, a deceiving God) and deliberately supposes a malicious demon to resist habit; then he finds one thing no deceiver can shake: he exists whenever he thinks, he is a thinking thing, and, as the wax shows, the mind is known better than the body.

oneLiner.zh: 罗素问：我们看到的是真实的桌子吗？——感官只给我们会变的表象，外部世界只能推出来，可以带一点怀疑地相信；范·因瓦根问：信念的真假由谁决定？——由世界本身决定，不由我们怎么想决定，所以有客观真理。
oneLiner.en: Russell asks whether the senses show us the real table (they give only changing appearances, and an independent world is a reasonable but unprovable belief); van Inwagen asks what makes our beliefs true (the World, not our minds, so there is objective truth).

oneLiner.zh: 休谟问：凭什么从“过去一直这样”推出“将来也会这样”？——没有任何推理做得到，带我们往前走的是习惯。古德曼问：同样的证据到底确证哪个假说？——grue 表明光看形式分不出来，这就是“归纳的新谜题”。
oneLiner.en: Hume asks what entitles us to move from 'it has always been so' to 'it will be so' (no reasoning does; custom carries us), and Goodman asks which hypotheses the same evidence confirms (grue shows that form alone cannot tell, which is the new riddle of induction).

oneLiner.zh: 内格尔：一个生物有意识，就是“做它是有某种样子的”；这种主观特征只能从某一类观点去把握，所以现有的物理还原解释不了它（物理主义也许是真的，但我们现在理解不了）。查默斯：把大脑的零件一个个换成功能完全相同的计算元件，意识最可能一直都在，所以足够好的上传体会有意识；可它是不是“我”，是另一个问题。
oneLiner.en: Nagel argues that a creature is conscious when there is something it is like to be it, and that this subjective character is tied to a point of view, so no current physical reduction can capture it; Chalmers argues that a functionally identical upload would very probably be conscious, but that this does not show the upload would be you.

oneLiner.zh: 和 ChatGPT 这类大语言模型聊天时，我们到底在和谁说话？查默斯的回答：不是模型本身，也不是哪一台服务器上的副本，而是一个“虚拟实例”（模型中途会换时，是一条“线程”）；它至少有准信念和准欲望，而且是真的“实现”了助手这样的人设（**persona**），不只是在假装。
oneLiner.en: Chalmers asks who we talk to when we talk to an LLM: not the model or any one hardware copy, but a virtual instance (or a thread when models change) that at least has quasi-beliefs and quasi-desires and really realizes a persona such as the Assistant.
